detail.title: Sr. Sales Manager - Walmart/Sam's Club
detail.jobDescription:
Position: Sr. Sales Manager – Walmart/Sam’s Club



Location: Bentonville, Arkansas


Position Summary:

Under the general direction of the VP of Sales and Sr. Director of Sales in the Home Entertainment department, Hisense is looking for a high-performing Sr. Sales Manager to help us meet our growth targets in television and sound bar in Walmart Stores and Sam’s Club. This person will be responsible for meeting television and sound bar sales goals, achieving forecast targets, crafting sell in plans and justifying plans with Hisense upper management and business planning. In addition, they are responsible for formulating innovative business development strategies and providing vision for sales strategies and their execution. This position will be responsible for maximizing marketing, advertising, events, and training budgets while ensuring Hisense is represented as a top leader in the industry.  They will act as the face of the company at various major retailers, while acting as a liaison for Hisense internal departments. 

 

Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with Sr. Director of Sales to develop short- and long-term strategic plans, including the preparation of annual Business plans and budget
  • Heavy involvement in creating and maintaining a 90 and 120-day rolling sell in plan by account
  • Conduct weekly and daily sales forecasts and account reviews to create reports and compare against objectives
  • Achieving shelf share goals during annual assortment summits by account
  • Conduct and help direct weekly/bi-weekly CPFR calls with customers along with business planning
  • Manage assigned budgets while consistently seeking revenue and cost optimization
  • Negotiate annual vendor program agreements by account while forecasting and tracking associated expenditures
  • Manage financial risks as it relates to customer deductions and offsets
  • Ensure organization-wide programs and events are administered, representing Hisense as a world class consumer electronics brand
  • Manage executive relationships and metrics with key regional accounts including inventory levels, turns, contracts, quarterly corporate business reviews, periodic business reviews, and drive increased sales within the accounts as assigned
  • Act as the liaison for assigned customer’s online portals

  

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher
  • At least 5 years of Sales experience with televisions and sound bars, preferably with Walmart or Sam’s Club
  • Experience developing sales forecasts
  • Experience with creating innovative business development strategies and providing vision for sales strategies and their execution

Overview:

The Director, Home Appliances – Pro Channel will be responsible for developing and executing the national strategy to grow Hisense's presence within the professional channel, including residential builders, multifamily developers, property management companies, kitchen and bath dealers, appliance distributors, buying groups, and other trade partners. This leader will drive profitable revenue growth by identifying new business opportunities, establishing strategic partnerships, and developing scalable sales programs that position Hisense as a preferred appliance brand within the new construction and renovation markets.

The Director will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including Go to Market, Product Planning, Marketing, Supply Chain, Customer Service, Finance, and Sales to ensure successful execution of channel strategies while delivering exceptional customer experiences.



Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute the national sales strategy for the Home Appliances Pro Channel, including builders, multifamily housing, property management, kitchen and bath dealers, appliance distributors, and other trade partners.
  • Identify, recruit, negotiate, and develop strategic relationships with key regional and national builders, developers, distributors, buying groups, and Pro channel partners.
  • Drive profitable revenue growth by expanding distribution, increasing specification opportunities, and growing market share across all major appliance categories.
  • Develop annual business plans with key accounts, including sales objectives, promotional strategies, product placement, inventory planning, and growth initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Marketing to develop channel-specific merchandising, promotional programs, digital assets, and sales tools that support customer acquisition and sell-through.
  • Partner with Product Management to communicate market trends, customer insights, competitive intelligence, and product opportunities that influence future product development.
  • Lead negotiations for national and regional agreements while ensuring profitable pricing, program execution, and long-term customer relationships.
  • Develop and implement training programs for builders, dealers, distributors, designers, and trade partners focused on product features, brand positioning, installation best practices, and competitive differentiation.
  • Work closely with Supply Chain, Logistics, Customer Service, and Operations to ensure exceptional order fulfillment, product availability, installation support, and post-sale customer satisfaction.
  • Establish sales forecasts, monitor business performance, and develop action plans to achieve revenue, profitability, and market share objectives.
  • Resolve customer concerns quickly while building trusted, long-term strategic partnerships.
  • Represent Hisense at industry trade shows, builder events, customer meetings, and professional organizations to strengthen brand awareness and generate new business opportunities.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships across internal functional teams to ensure seamless execution of strategic initiatives.



Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field preferred
  • 8+ years of progressive sales leadership experience within the home appliance, building products, kitchen and bath, construction, or related industries.
  • Proven experience selling into the Pro Channel, including residential builders, multifamily developers, appliance distributors, kitchen and bath dealers, property management companies, buying groups, or related trade channels.
  • Demonstrated success developing strategic business plans and delivering consistent revenue and profit growth.
  • Strong understanding of the residential construction, remodeling, and appliance distribution industries.
  • Experience negotiating national and regional customer agreements with executive-level decision makers.
  • Excellent relationship-building skills with the ability to influence customers, partners, and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong financial acumen with experience managing forecasts, pricing strategies, margins, and profitability.
  • Exceptional presentation, communication, and negotiation skills.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and drive execution across Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Supply Chain, and Customer Service.
  • Self-motivated leader capable of managing multiple priorities while operating effectively in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.
  • Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, Teams) and CRM platforms.
  • Ability to travel as necessary throughout the United States.



Preferred Experience:

  • Experience working with national or regional home builders, multifamily developers, buying groups, appliance distributors, or kitchen and bath networks.

Location: Remote in the NW region of U.S., must live in either the state of Washington or Oregon


Overview:

The After Sales Support & Training Manager will be responsible for delivering regional technical support, product training, and field service assistance for Hisense HVAC residential and light commercial products within the assigned market. This role will serve as a key technical resource for distributors, contractors, sales teams, and internal support teams by answering technical support calls, providing in-person and remote training, and supporting occasional on-site startup, troubleshooting, and quality assurance testing for inverter unitary side discharge, top discharge, ductless, and VRF products, with a primary focus on single-phase applications


Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary after-sales technical support and training resource for Hisense HVAC products within the assigned region.
  • Answer incoming technical support calls and provide clear, professional troubleshooting guidance to distributors, contractors, sales representatives, and internal support teams.
  • Provide in-person, remote, and classroom-based training for distributors and contractors covering installation, startup, service, troubleshooting, and best practices for Hisense HVAC products.

  • Associate degree or HVAC related technical certification required. Bachelor’s degree is preferred.

  • Experience providing classroom and hand-on HVAC technical training.

detail.title: Bilingual Trade Compliance Specialist
detail.jobDescription:
Overview:

The Trade Compliance Specialist will support the execution and continuous improvement of the company’s U.S. import trade compliance program, with a primary focus on regulatory compliance, policy implementation, and operational support. The position will work closely with customs brokers and internal stakeholders to ensure accurate and compliant import transactions in accordance with U.S. Customs regulations. In addition to core compliance activities, this role will also support internal reporting and communication in both English and Mandarin.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support day-to-day U.S. import trade compliance activities, ensuring accurate and timely import filings in coordination with customs brokers
  • Review and maintain import documentation and compliance data to ensure accuracy, completeness, and regulatory recordkeeping requirements
  • Assist with tariff classification (HTS), customs valuation, and country-of-origin determination processes
  • Track and analyze updates in U.S. import regulations, trade policies, tariffs, and trade remedies, and support internal implementation
  • Partner with logistics, supply chain, and relevant functions to identify compliance risks and address operational issues
  • Support post-entry reviews, compliance checks, and responses to customs inquiries
  • Assist with internal compliance audits and data validation to ensure adherence to company policies and regulatory standards
  • Maintain and organize compliance-related records and documentation in line with internal and regulatory requirements
  • Prepare internal reports, compliance summaries, and presentations (including Chinese-language materials) for cross-functional and global stakeholders
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives related to import compliance processes, data accuracy, and operational efficiency



Qualifications:

  • 2–3 years of experience in import operations, customs brokerage, trade compliance, or supply chain/logistics-related roles
  • Basic understanding of U.S. import regulations and customs processes (e.g., HTS classification, valuation, origin, documentation)

detail.title: Logistics Inbound Manager
detail.jobDescription:
Overview:

The Logistics Inbound Manager is the role for optimizing and streamlining the supply chain and logistics operations of the company. The primary responsibility will be to lead the end-to-end logistics process from Mexico factory or China origin through final customers. It will analyze and evaluate the entire logistics process and operation data, identifying areas for improvement and implementing strategies to enhance efficiency and cost-effectiveness. Analytical skills and attention to detail will be instrumental in ensuring smooth and timely movement of goods throughout the supply chain, minimizing delays and maximizing customer satisfaction.

 

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Data Analysis: Collect, analyze, and interpret data related to logistics operations, including transportation, warehousing, inventory, and distribution. Use this data to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Monitor shipments and ensure that they are delivered on time and in good condition.
  • Supply Chain Optimization: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including procurement, operations, and customer service, to optimize the supply chain process. Ensure the right products are available at the right locations and at the right times to meet customer demands.
  • Performance Metrics: Develop and maintain key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the efficiency and effectiveness of logistics processes. Regularly monitor and report on KPIs to identify deviations and propose corrective actions.
  • Cost Management: Identify cost-saving opportunities within the logistics process while maintaining high-quality standards. Analyze vendor performance costs, transportation and warehousing costs, negotiate contracts, and work to reduce overall expenses.

 

Qualifications/Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations Management, Business Management or a related field of study
  • 3 or more years of relevant experience in Logistics or Supply Chain
  • Some Supply Chain experience with international suppliers and carriers
  • Ability to lead the full end-to-end process with experience in international shipment management and carrier management, as well as order management and cost analysis
  • Capability to manage and lead carrier bidding processes
  • Ability to perform daily, weekly, and monthly monitoring, and to troubleshoot issues with cross-functional teams
  • Proficient in Excel (Pivot Table & Lookup function are required) and PowerPoint
  • Strong written and verbal communication and negotiation skills
  • Willing and able to travel internationally and domestically (up to 50%)


Preferred Skills:

  • Bilingual in English and Chinese (Mandrin) or Spanish
  • Electronics logistics experience preferred
  • Experience with SAP and TMS or other logistics software preferred

detail.title: Logistics Planning & Analytics Manager
detail.jobDescription:
Overview:

The Logistics Planning & Analytics Manager is a data-driven leader responsible for forecasting, modeling, and reporting logistics and warehouse operations. This role drives decision-making through KPI management, predictive analytics, and performance reporting, ensuring operational efficiency, cost control, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate combines deep analytical skills with practical logistics experience to transform data into actionable insights and executive-level presentations.


Responsibilities:

Logistics Forecasting & Modeling

  • Build, maintain, and continuously improve logistics and warehouse forecasting models for capacity, inventory flow, and seasonal demand
  • Develop predictive analytics to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for cost savings and operational efficiency
  • Support strategic planning initiatives by providing data-driven recommendations


KPI Management & Data Analytics

  • Own core warehouse and logistics KPIs, including:
    • Logistics Expense Rate
    • Inventory Accuracy
    • Damage Rate
    • Warehouse Utilization Rate
  • Collect, validate, and analyze KPI data from multiple systems (WMS, ERP, 3PL data)
  • Identify gaps, trends, and anomalies in operational performance


Reporting & Presentations

  • Create clear, actionable, and visually compelling dashboards and reports using Power BI and Advanced Excel
  • Prepare executive-level presentations and operational summaries for leadership review
  • Translate complex data into insights that drive decisions on space utilization, cost reduction, and service improvements


Process Improvement & Collaboration

  • Partner with warehouse operations, finance, and 3PL providers to implement improvements informed by data insights
  • Recommend and support system enhancements, automation, and best practices
  • Lead initiatives to reduce logistics costs, improve inventory accuracy, and optimize warehouse space


*Ability to travel up to 25% of the time as required.


Skills & Qualifications:

Technical Skills:

  • Advanced proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, Power Query, complex formulas)
  • Strong experience with Power BI or similar data visualization tools
  • Data analytics and statistical modeling experience
  • Experience with WMS/ERP systems
  • Forecasting, scenario modeling, and KPI analysis


Professional Skills:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
  • Ability to synthesize complex data into executive-level insights and presentations
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy and actionable insights
  • Effective collaboration and communication across cross-functional teams


Experience:

  • 7+ years in logistics, warehouse operations, or supply chain analytics
  • Proven track record in logistics forecasting, KPI management, and reporting
  • Experience working with 3PL providers preferred


Key Success Metrics:

  • Accurate and actionable logistics forecasting
  • Improved KPI performance: lower expense rate, higher inventory accuracy, reduced damage, better warehouse utilization
  • High-quality dashboards and presentations that inform leadership decisions
  • Continuous improvement initiatives implemented and measured

detail.title: Senior Planning Analyst
detail.jobDescription:
JOB TITLE: Senior Planning Analyst



JOB DUTIES:

Senior Planning Analyst is responsible for demand & supply forecasting, inventory optimization, production planning, & cross-functional coordination to ensure efficient, data-driven supply chain operations & performance. Specific job duties include, but are not limited to the following:


  1. Collect and analyze sell-in forecasts from the sales team, transforming these data points into comprehensive supply forecasts using Data Analysis (Excel). Ensure these forecasts account for arrival schedules, existing inventory levels, and potential market fluctuations to maintain an optimal Demand & Supply Planning.
  2. Evaluate orders with the factory based on its production capacity & capability under Production & Capacity Planning. Strategically schedule orders to align with customer demand while minimizing inventory costs. This involves close coordination with the factory & internal teams under Cross-functional Coordination, ensuring timely & efficient production planning while avoiding overstock & stockouts.
  3. Update & maintain daily inventory reports using ERP Systems (SAP) & Data Analysis (Excel), providing accurate & timely data on current inventory levels. Monitor inventory turnover rates; apply Inventory Management principles to ensure efficient use of resources. Collaborate with the sales team; develop strategies for managing & reducing aging inventory, optimizing stock levels & improving overall inventory health.
  4. Work closely with various departments, including sales, production, and logistics, under Cross-functional Coordination, to align supply chain activities with overall business goals. Foster strong communication channels to facilitate smooth flow of information; address any supply chain issues promptly.
  5. Identify opportunities for process improvements within the supply chain; implement best practices and innovative solutions. Enhance forecasting accuracy under Demand & Supply Planning, improve inventory control under Inventory Management; optimize order fulfillment processes to increase overall efficiency and effectiveness.
  6. Develop & implement Production planning strategies to improve operational efficiency, throughput & order fulfillment performance.
  7. Design & implement inventory optimization frameworks, including safety stock modeling & reorder point analysis, applying Inventory Management and optimization, Inventory reporting, and Data Analysis (Excel; Power BI) to support efficient inventory positioning.
  8. Lead cross-functional coordination by consolidating inputs from sales, operations & finance teams under aligning demand, supply & business objectives.
  9. Identify constraints & conduct supply chain risk assessment by analyzing demand variability, supply disruptions & capacity constraints using Data Analysis (Excel; Power BI) and Supply chain risk assessment, while applying Production & Capacity Planning and Demand & Supply Planning to develop mitigation strategies ensuring operational continuity.
  10. Lead Supply chain process improvement initiatives and planning system enhancements, including automation, data integration & workflow optimization, leveraging ERP Systems (SAP), and Data Analysis (Excel; Power BI) to drive operational efficiency.
  11. Develop and maintain supply chain KPI development & performance tracking frameworks using Data Analysis (Excel; Power BI) & Inventory reporting to measure forecasting accuracy, planning efficiency & overall supply chain performance.
  12. Utilize MS Excel and Power BI to prepare executive-level summaries, dashboards, and planning insights, applying & integrating outputs from ERP Systems (SAP) to support data-driven decision-making across the supply chain.
  13. Provide data-driven recommendations based on data analysis to support strategic supply chain planning & continuous improvement initiatives.



JOB REQUIREMENTS:

 At least a Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business, or a closely related field, plus minimum Two years of post-baccalaureate experience working as Supply Chain Planning Analyst, Supply Chain Analyst, Logistics Analyst, Logistics Engineers, or closely related positions. Foreign degree equivalent is acceptable. We will also accept any suitable combination of education, training and/or experience. Experience should include working on Demand and Supply Planning; Production and Capacity Planning; Inventory Management; Inventory reporting; Cross-functional Coordination; order fulfillment processes optimization; Monitoring inventory turnover rates; Supply chain process improvement; working with Data Analysis Excel, and ERP Systems (SAP).

 

HOURS: M-F, 9:00 a.m. – 6:00 p.m.

 

JOB LOCATION: Alpharetta, GA 30005
